1.13.summary: 24 bug-fix tasks across 7 areas of one production codebase (LLM API integration, agent loop, billing, cloud, product/UX, memory and tools, hard multi-site fixes). Tasks are bugs fixed by real merged pull requests in one large production codebase frozen at a snapshot; the model gets a bug report and the repository and works with tools; hidden tests check the fix, and a fix that breaks existing behaviour scores 0. Not public: only per-subcategory scores per model are published; no task files on Hugging Face or GitHub. Yugos's catalog lists SWE-bench Verified (the same task type) under agentic.
